meta.title: MeasureSoftGram
meta.description: Measure your software quality objectively, based on metrics collected from your own pipeline.

hero.title: Measure your software quality objectively
hero.subtitle: MeasureSoftGram collects metrics from your repository, applies a configurable quality model and turns the numbers into clear dashboards to track how your releases evolve.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From code to a quality indicator in four steps.

register.title: Register your product
register.description: Create your organization and register the software products you want to track.

connect.title: Connect the repositories
connect.description: Link the product repositories and define what should be measured in each of them.

collect.title: Collect metrics in CI
collect.description: Continuous integration sends your pipeline metrics on every analysis, with no manual work.

visualize.title: Track the dashboards
visualize.description: Visualize characteristics, subcharacteristics and quality evolution across releases.

value.title: Why use MeasureSoftGram
value.subtitle: Quality decisions backed by data, not perception.

model.title: Configurable quality model
model.description: Set weights per characteristic and subcharacteristic to reflect your product priorities.

dashboards.title: Quality dashboards
dashboards.description: Objective, visual indicators that make the state of the software easy to share with the team.

releases.title: Release comparison
releases.description: Define reference values and track whether each release moves toward or away from the quality goal.

community.title: Learn more about the project
community.subtitle: MeasureSoftGram is an open project maintained by the community.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.description: Usage guides, architecture and how to integrate MeasureSoftGram into your workflow.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Explore the source code of the project components and contribute.

app.title: Dashboards
app.description: Open the system and visualize the quality of your products.
